tariq (newhire): hi team, attempting my first PR build for the onboarding exercises. i triggered the pipeline but it immediately shows "no agents match tags" in the UI. i used tag 'linux-small' like the doc says. any idea?
alejandra (infra): welcome! sometimes forks don't have the repo-level webhook permissions so the pipeline can schedule but agents can't pick it up. is this a forked repo or branch inside the org?
tariq (newhire): forked. had to open a PR from my fork because i couldn't push to main.
sam (devex): ah that explains it. our shared agents only accept jobs from org repos by default (to avoid running arbitrary fork CI). we have a couple of options: 1) run in the dedicated onboarding pool (we can allow your PR temporarily), 2) ask infra to add your fork's repo to the buildkite app install, or 3) push to a branch on the main org if you have permission.
tariq (newhire): option 1 would be easiest for me. how do i request that?
alejandra (infra): i can flip a setting to allow builds from forks for the onboarding pipeline, but that needs an explicit approve. file request with reason: "onboarding new hire PR" and i'll approve. give me the PR link.
tariq (newhire): https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding/pull/12 here it is. thanks!
buildkite-bot: Build scheduled: onboarding/first-build #45 (triggered by tariq (newhire)). Waiting for agents tagged: [linux-small].
sam (devex): i also see we have a tag mismatch. the onboarding pool agents use tag `onboarding-linux` not `linux-small`. try adding `tags=[onboarding-linux]` to the run comment or update the pipeline config in your PR to use that tag.
tariq (newhire): ah, that was it. updated the PR pipeline stanza to use `onboarding-linux` and commented `@buildkite run pipeline:onboarding/first-build tags=[onboarding-linux]`.
buildkite-bot: Pipeline scheduled by tariq (newhire). Matching agents found.
tariq (newhire): build started! failing early with `bash: ./scripts/setup-local.sh: Permission denied` in the container step. new problem :)
sam (devex): the container step runs as a non-root user. try `chmod +x scripts/setup-local.sh` in your branch or use `shell: bash -lc "chmod +x scripts/setup-local.sh && ./scripts/setup-local.sh"` in the step.
tariq (newhire): pushed fix, re-running. build passed all steps. thanks for the quick help and warm welcome! :party_parrot:
alejandra (infra): welcome aboard — ping #devex if you want a quick walkthrough of CI agent tags and best practices.
